    Image-closed subcategories as interval families #

    By Theorem 5.5, the image-closed subcategories of mod Λ_n correspond to the intersection-closed families of intervals 𝕀(C) (Definition 5.4). This file sets up the families as finite sets of pairs (a, d) with a ≤ d in Fin n (IntervalFamily, ClosedFamily), the bijection with ImageClosedSubcategory (imageClosedEquiv), and the weight x^{ρ_n(C)} q^{|ind C|} in these terms (fWeight): ρ_n counts the intervals ending at the last vertex and |ind C| is the size of the family.
